subject: Environmental Studies
stem: The plant vascular tissue responsible for transporting water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots to the leaves is:
explanation: Xylem transports water and minerals unidirectionally from roots to leaves — phloem, by contrast, transports food (sugars made during photosynthesis) both up and down the plant, from leaves to storage/growing regions.

subject: Environmental Studies
stem: The plant vascular tissue responsible for transporting food (sugars manufactured during photosynthesis) from the leaves to other parts of the plant, including roots and storage organs, is:
explanation: Phloem carries manufactured food (mainly sucrose) from the leaves (source) to other parts of the plant (sinks) — unlike xylem, which carries only water and minerals, always upward from the roots.
